# Learning: Short Title

## Lesson

State the reusable conclusion first.

## Context And Symptom

What work exposed this, and what would a future contributor observe?

## Cause Or Explanation

What was misunderstood or non-obvious?

## Check First

List the shortest useful checks, relevant files, or commands.

## Verified Approach

Describe the resolution or working method and how it was verified.

## Avoid

Record the incorrect assumption, ineffective approach, or unsafe shortcut that
should not be repeated.

## References

Link relevant files, plans, commits, upstream issues, or stable documentation.

## Search Keywords

List concrete errors, dependency names, paths, build steps, targets, and
upstream project names.
